title: 拖放
summary: 同一抓取手势，松手提交的不是同一种结果。先定是新顺序、一次接收、跨组转移，还是无效回弹。
summaryEn: The same grab does not commit the same thing. First decide: a new order, a single receive, a cross-list transfer, or an invalid snap-back.
asks: 这一拖提交的是新顺序、一次接收、跨组转移，还是无效回弹？
asksEn: Does this drag commit a new order, a single receive, a cross-list transfer, or an invalid snap-back?

links.when: 拖放提交不是视线落到格子
links.whenEn: a drag commit is not gaze landing on a cell
not advancing a product by turning its angle
